palm.rule: Current full-data alternating block step eta=1/Lhat, using five normalized Hessian applications and a sixth norm evaluation.
palm.stochasticity: Fresh Gaussian power directions; evaluate all three oracle/power seed labels.

prox_sarah.source: Section 5 numerical variant with Section 3.4 constant-step parameter coupling
prox_sarah.updates_per_epoch: one snapshot update plus m recursive updates
prox_sarah.fixed_scale: Lhat=c_L*(L_U^0+L_V^0); c_L selected on original development cases only
prox_sarah.scale_status: Practical development-tuned smoothness estimate, not a certified global Lipschitz upper bound

development.recording: initial, final, and last native within-cap observation
development.eligibility: All 12 runs completed with finite within-budget repaired/initial loss <=1.
development.ranking: Median over the four slice/view cells of their three-seed median loss ratios; ties favor larger c_L.
development.expansion: If the eligible winner is at a tested edge, evaluate all 12 cases at the next factor-two value on that edge, then reselect. With no eligible candidate, expand only the safer upper edge. Stop for review if the winner is at a guard edge or no eligible candidate exists at the upper guard.
development.failures: Keep scientific nonfinite failures as ineligible outcomes and continue all scheduled cases; operational or projection failures halt for review.

work.palm_per_iteration: 2 gradients +12 full-data Hessian applications =14N views per direction
work.prox_per_iteration: Full snapshot: one gradient on N views; recursive update: two gradients on b views

implementation_scope: Published practical numerical variants adapted to CT; neither power estimates nor tuned Lhat are certified theorem constants.
publication: Follow the completed SPRING paper update, preserve all other arms, and add no figures.
